# ANVIL rules: php

Follow these rules for php code (**/*.php).

## PHP

# PHP
- `declare(strict_types=1);` typed signatures.
- Prepared statements / query builder only; escape output.
- PSR-12 style; static analysis (PHPStan/Psalm) clean.
